name: Gong Zhu
summary: Chinese reverse trick-taking game like Hearts where Queen of Spades is the pig penalty and Jack of Diamonds and Ten of Clubs are bonuses.
rules_text: 4-5 players use 52 cards (with 2 cards removed for 5 players). Deal all cards anticlockwise, no passing. Must follow suit if able; highest of led suit wins trick. Card values: Qs -100, Ah -50, Kh -40, Qh -30, Jh -20, 10h-6h -10 each, 4h-2h 0, Jd +100, 10c +50 if alone else doubles owner's other point cards. Taking all hearts is +200 not -200; taking all hearts plus Qs is +300. Before play, Ah, Qs, Jd, 10c may be exposed to double (Ah doubles all hearts, Qs -200, Jd +200, 10c quadruples). Exposed card cannot be played on first lead of its suit unless no alternative. Keep cumulative scores; first to -1000 loses.
rating_reason: Hearts variant with expose doubling, reverse trick-taking strategic
